state:
**Side goal `fmt-layout-from-breaks`: stages 2 and 3 have landed except shape types. Stage 4 has landed for lists.** `nvs fmt` lays out lists (`crates/nvs-fmt/src/list.rs`), `->` / `?->` call chains and `&&`, `||`, `??`, `.` chains, plus broken conditions (`crates/nvs-fmt/src/chain.rs`).

The editor actions *Put on separate lines* and *Join onto one line* exist for lists. `nvs_fmt::relayout` (`crates/nvs-fmt/src/split_join.rs`) writes the breaks, formats the file, and returns the formatted list as the edit. If formatting changed anything outside the list, the edit is the breaks alone. The LSP side is `crates/nvs-lsp/src/split_join.rs`, filed under `refactor.rewrite` and offered beside the html-template refactor in `crates/nvs-lsp/src/actions.rs`. The check `split-and-join-actions` has three cases under `tests/lsp/actions/`, and all of them pass.

`rule:ide/a-list-splits-onto-lines-and-joins-onto-one` stays `designed` because the call chain and operator chain actions are not written yet. `rule:tooling/fmt-a-list-is-one-line-or-one-item-per-line` stays `designed` because of shape types (gap `comma-separated-list-whose-closing-delimiter`).

The split adds a break before the first arrow and lets the format pass lay out the rest, the same way lists work today.

**An operator chain is offered the same actions** (same rule): `crates/nvs-fmt/src/chain.rs:276` `Operators`, again through `crates/nvs-fmt/src/split_join.rs:74`. A broken condition's `(` and `)` come from the format pass.
